runs.question: How long after OMB M-25-22 is issued does it start to apply to new AI contracts?

answer.text:
OMB M-25-22 applies to new AI contracts 180 days after the memorandum is issued. It covers any contract awarded pursuant to a solicitation issued on or after the date that is 180 days after issuance of this memorandum. The same 180-day date also governs option exercises: the memo reaches any option to renew or extend the period of performance exercised on an existing contract after the date that is 180 days after the issuance of this memorandum.

The passages do not give the exact calendar date, since they don't state the issuance day beyond the title's "April 2025." The memo also excludes some uses: it does not apply to AI acquired for use as a component of a National Security System.
